sql_visualizer_snippets.title: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LEAD/LAG, FIRST/LAST_VALUE
sql_visualizer_snippets.sql:
WITH ranked_orders AS (
    SELECT id, user_id, amount, created_at, order_date, sale_date, revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn,
        LAG(amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at) AS prev_amount,
        LEAD(amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at) AS next_amount,
        FIRST_VALUE(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at) AS initial_purchase,
        LAST_VALUE(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS latest_purchase,
        SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total,
        AVG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY sale_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3d
    FROM orders
)
SELECT * FROM ranked_orders WHERE rn = 1;
sql_visualizer_snippets.description: Core window functions for ranking, running totals, lead/lag offsets, and moving aggregations

FROM employees;

sql_visualizer_snippets.title: Mermaid: Shapes, Links & Logic
sql_visualizer_snippets.sql:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Logic [Basic Logic & State Machine]
        L_A[Start] --> L_B{Condition}
        L_B -- Да --> L_C[Do something]
        L_B -- Нет --> L_D[Do nothing]
        L_C --> L_E[Конец]
        L_D --> L_E
        
        SM_S(((Start))) --> SM_1((State 1))
        SM_1 --> SM_2((State 2))
        SM_2 --> SM_E(((End)))
        SM_1 -- loop --> SM_1
        SM_2 -- retry --> SM_1
    end

    subgraph Shapes [All Supported Shapes]
        SH_A[Rectangle] --> SH_B(Stadium / Pill)
        SH_B --> SH_C((Circle))
        SH_C --> SH_D{Rhombus / Decision}
        SH_D --> SH_E{{Hexagon}}
        SH_E --> SH_F[[Subroutine]]
        SH_F --> SH_G[(Database)]
        SH_G --> SH_H>Asymmetric Block]
        SH_H --> SH_I[/Trapezoid\]
        SH_I --> SH_J[\Inverted Trapezoid/]
    end

    subgraph Edges [Lines, Labels & Links]
        E_A[Source] --- E_B[No Arrow]
        E_A --> E_C[Standard Arrow]
        E_A === E_D[Thick Arrow]
        E_A -.- E_E[Dotted Arrow]
        
        E_B -->|Text 1| E_F[Target 1]
        E_C -- Text 2 --> E_G[Target 2]
        E_D == Text 3 ==> E_H[Target 3]
        E_E -. Text 4 .-> E_I[Target 4]

        M_A[Source 1] & M_B[Source 2] --> M_C[Handler 1] & M_D[Handler 2]
        M_C & M_D --> M_E(((Result)))
    end
sql_visualizer_snippets.description: Cheat-sheet for shapes, line types, multi-links, and basic logic
